the use of species-area relationships (i.e. SARs) to set habitat targets in marine conservation planning can provide significant improvements in the representation of habitats and the protection of species.

conservation planning should not be based on fixed percentage (uniform) habitat targets, and that SARs can be used to set habitat conservation targets for fish, molluscs and other taxa in marine protected area design.
